latestAction.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

summary.text: This resolution sets forth two articles of impeachment against President Donald Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors on charges of (1) abuse of presidential power by calling for the execution of Members of Congress, and (2) abuse of presidential power to intimidate federal judges in violation of the separation of powers and independence of the judiciary.

title: Impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States for high crimes and misdemeanors.
